requirements.quote: Bid offered should be valid for a period of 180 Days from the date of opening of RFP response.
requirements.text: The bid must remain valid for 180 days from the RFP response opening date.

requirements.quote: Conditional offers are liable for rejection.

ITI LTD reserves the right to verify the correctness of the client certificates (PO Copies/Work orders) and any other information submitted by the bidder in his offer.  In case of any wrong information submitted by bidder, the bid will be rejected and subsequently the bidder will be blacklisted from doing any business with ITI Limited.
requirements.text: ITI LTD may verify submitted information and blacklist bidders for false submissions.

requirements.quote: If the Partner is supplied the same Product/different Product to any of the ITI Projects before, ITI has the full right to evaluate the performance and quality of supply of the Partner.
requirements.text: ITI may evaluate the bidder's past performance on previous projects.

requirements.quote: The Bidders should give Clause by clause compliance (as per Annexure III) of RFP with references to supporting documents; otherwise the offers are liable for rejection.
requirements.text: Bidders must provide clause-by-clause compliance with supporting documents.

requirements.quote: The bid documents (to be uploaded on the e-tendering portal) should be numbered in order of Check list.
requirements.text: Bid documents must be numbered according to the checklist.

requirements.quote: In the event that ITI LTD is required to provide demonstration or working of the product to their buyers, the same shall be arranged by the bidder at latter’s cost and expenditure.
requirements.text: Bidders must arrange product demonstrations at their own cost if required.

requirements.quote: ITI LTD reserves the right to suspend or cancel the RFP process at any stage, to accept, or reject any, or all offers at any stage of the process and / or to modify the process, or any part thereof, at any time without assigning any reason, without any obligation or liability whatsoever.
requirements.text: ITI LTD can modify, suspend, or cancel the RFP process at any stage without obligation.

requirements.quote: Bidders, whose Purchase Order(s) for any Project of ITI LTD was/were cancelled on risk & cost basis for nonperformance or non-submission of performance guarantee in last 2 years, are not eligible to participate in this tender.
requirements.text: Bidders with canceled ITI LTD projects in the last 2 years are ineligible.

requirements.quote: The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his offer against this RFP, including cost of presentation for the purposes of clarification of the offer, if so desired by ITI LTD. ITI LTD will, in no case be responsible or liable for those costs, regardless of the conduct or outcome of the RFP process.
requirements.text: Bidders bear all costs for preparing and submitting their offers.

requirements.quote: At any time prior to the last date for receipt of offers, ITI LTD, may, for any reason, whether at its own initiative or in response to a clarification requested by a prospective bidder, modify the RFP document by an amendment. In order to provide prospective bidder reasonable time in which to take the amendment into account in preparing their offers, ITI LTD may, at their discretion, extend the last
requirements.text: ITI LTD may amend the RFP and extend deadlines if needed.
